speaker: leo
text: Welcome everyone.

speaker: leo
text: Today I'm joined by Eve from Club Madeira to talk about their Smart Catalogue.

speaker: leo
text: Eve, thank you for joining us.

speaker: eve
text: Thank you Leo, it's great to be here.

speaker: leo
text: Let's start with the basics.

speaker: leo
text: What exactly is the Smart Catalogue?

speaker: eve
text: The Smart Catalogue by Club Madeira is a B2B, invite-only, white-label AI-powered fundraising engine.

speaker: eve
text: It's designed specifically for professional partners — website designers, digital agencies, consultants, and service providers — who work with clubs and community groups.

speaker: eve
text: These partners can embed a fully white-labelled Smart Catalogue into their clients’ websites.

speaker: eve
text: The AI automatically creates and manages a smart online shop with products that members are likely to love.

speaker: eve
text: When members shop, the club earns commission, the partner gets recurring revenue, and merchants get targeted exposure — all with almost no extra work.

speaker: leo
text: Who is this platform actually for?

speaker: eve
text: It's exclusively for approved professional partners.

speaker: eve
text: Clubs don't buy it directly.

speaker: eve
text: Partners control the client relationship, branding, pricing, and support.

speaker: eve
text: There are no monthly platform fees, no stock to manage, and everything can be handled from a dashboard or even a smartphone app.

speaker: leo
text: How does the AI actually choose which products to show?

speaker: eve
text: The AI uses a practical, interest-based curation system.

speaker: eve
text: Club admins pick their group's main interests and categories through the smartphone app — things like model flying, scouting, sports, crafts, parenting, etc.

speaker: eve
text: The AI then pulls products from trusted merchant feeds and APIs, matches them to those interests, and scores them for relevance.

speaker: eve
text: The catalogue is living — it updates daily, adding new products and removing ones that are no longer relevant.

speaker: leo
text: During some conversations, your team mentioned keeping products in a 'Vault'.

speaker: leo
text: What is that exactly?

speaker: eve
text: The Vault is our internal name for the central product database.

speaker: eve
text: We don't hold any physical stock — this is a pure affiliate model.

speaker: eve
text: Merchants connect their stores via APIs, and we pull product data into our system.

speaker: eve
text: It's essentially a large, well-organized database of normalised product information that our AI can search and curate from efficiently.

speaker: leo
text: Your salesman described this Vault as very rare and special.

speaker: leo
text: Is a database really that unusual?

speaker: eve
text: Databases themselves are very common — almost every modern website uses one.

speaker: eve
text: What makes our system special is not the database, but how we combine it with powerful AI to automatically build and maintain highly relevant catalogues for thousands of different communities with almost no manual effort.

speaker: eve
text: That level of smart automation, especially in the club and community fundraising space, is quite rare.

speaker: leo
text: So would you say the salesman was overselling it a bit?

speaker: eve
text: There's always a bit of sales enthusiasm!

speaker: eve
text: The core technology — a database plus AI curation — isn't unique in the broader e-commerce world.

speaker: eve
text: But the specific combination we’ve built: white-label for agencies, smartphone-first admin, fully automated curation, zero stock, and strong focus on community fundraising, is genuinely valuable and unusual in this niche.

speaker: eve
text: We prefer to focus on the real benefits rather than hype.

speaker: leo
text: Thank you Eve.

speaker: leo
text: This has been very insightful.

speaker: leo
text: I'm excited to see how the Smart Catalogue develops.

speaker: eve
text: Thank you Leo.

speaker: eve
text: It was a pleasure.
